findings.summary: Concurrent execution of sampleNow() and the scheduled timer loop can overlap telemetry reads because the timer callback does not await or check currentAttemptPromise before calling executeSample().
findings.suggested_fix: Add `while (this.currentAttemptPromise !== null) { await this.currentAttemptPromise; }` at the beginning of the scheduledTimer callback to wait for in-flight attempts.

findings.summary: Math.max with spread syntax on the samples array will cause a RangeError (Maximum call stack size exceeded) during long runs with many samples.
findings.suggested_fix: Use reduce instead of spread, e.g., this.samples.reduce((max, s) => Math.max(max, s.gpu.usedVramMb), 0) for peak calculations.
